meanings.definition: Toasted bread.; A proposed salutation (e.g. to say "cheers") while drinking alcohol.
examples: I ate a piece of toast for breakfast.
At the reception, there were many toasts from the well-wishers.
He was the toast of high society.

meanings.definition: To lightly cook by browning via direct exposure to a fire or other heat source.; To grill, lightly cook by browning specifically under a grill or in a toaster
examples: We liked to toast marshmallows around the campfire.
Top with cheese and toast under the grill for a few minutes.
We toasted the happy couple many times over the course of the evening.

meanings.definition: (Plural form) One who reaps.; (Plural form) A machine used to harvest crops.
examples: The local reapers gathered early in the square to prepare their daily exhibits.
Multiple sudden reapers swept across the region, overwhelming the drainage canals.
Scholars compared various reapers preserved from centuries of documented history.
